observations: I read assets/panels/04-1.png, main-cast.png, nurse.png, checkin-patients.png and vision-cast.png with Read. Ravi matches main-cast: side-parted short black hair, trimmed beard, thick straight brows, warm creased eyes, light green shirt with rolled sleeves, dark trousers, and the watch on his left wrist.

Ravi is standing, smiling and looking up to screen-right at the wall TV in the upper right. The TV screen is light teal with one empty white strip. It shows no numbers or text, so the lettered 'NOW · A-12' label can go on it.

His left hand, with the watch, holds the brown shoulder-bag strap on his left shoulder, and the bag hangs at his hip. His right hand is pushed into his trouser pocket. The phone itself is not visible, but this reads acceptably as 'tucking the phone away'.

The waiting chairs to screen-left of him are empty, and two other waiting patients are seen from behind further back. Meera, with her side braid and blue kurta, sits behind the reception monitor at the right with her hands at the keyboard. She is smiling up rather than looking at the screen, which is acceptable for a background figure.

The QR stand at the left shows only an abstract block pattern with no text. A vitals cart with a cuff and an oximeter is visible behind Ravi, which sets up 04-2's vitals corner. No readable text appears anywhere.

There is a flat white rectangle at the upper left for the caption. It has a hard lower edge across the wall and window, so lettering must cover it. That is a lettering-stage check and is not certified here.
Continuity: the bag is on his left shoulder here, matching 07-1 and 07-2, and it is on the floor during the vitals check and consultation (04-2, 05-1, 06-2).
